name: Barnwell
gaps: Source query returned 4435 rows; 4150 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Barnwell County ParcelData_ExportFeatures (parcels joined to CAMA, county AGOL BarnwellCountySC) (https://services8.arcgis.com/qqnlHdXochyJPfSY/arcgis/rest/services/ParcelData_ExportFeatures/FeatureServer/2). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
tax usable: County-published CAMA join on parcel polygons (Barnwell County AGOL, edited 2026-09). No single total-market field — sum components.
sale usable: Format: integer YYYYMMDD — parse with strptime(str(v),"%Y%m%d"); filter Consideration__>100 for arm-length prices.
owner usable: Owner + mailing address public on county layer.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
SCDOT statewide SC_Parcels requires token — not usable as primary.
